protocol.branch: First actual main-arm wound, armed getup with extra activation >1e-4, then first active-to-held-zero-delta boundary. All runs are independent from spawn and replay exactly up to that same complete-step boundary.
protocol.treatment: Temporary ordinary-muscle routing only inside original driveSword and/or driveJoints+elbowGravity calls. Independent filter updates continue in original step; flag and filter are restored/unchanged before next method. allOrdinary is a diagnostic ablation after independent prefix, NOT legacy from spawn.
protocol.scope: driveSword includes IK gate and wrist torque/braking; driveJoints includes manual shoulder and native elbow; jointsOrdinary also routes separate elbowGravity. Other muscles, inputs, gains, strength, health, native poses and AI are unchanged.
protocol.observation: Original methods called exactly once. Actual addTorque values include final twist and actual recipients; instantaneous pre-solver recipient power is NOT integrated native work. Elbow motor settings are requests, not achieved torque/whole-substep work. Contact points/normal impulses remain last-solver-substep raw; no per-point load or COP inference.
protocol.inference: First dispatch and first physics response are local same-state path contrasts. Direct same-recorded-event windows and complete .5s reactive-AI outcomes are reported separately; later treatment-induced AI/contact changes are mediators of total game effect, not automatically invalidating paired whole-window regression. Not equal-torque efficiency or human acceptance.
protocol.referenceGate: All pre-branch and full-mode post-branch frame digests must match the previously received original from-spawn raw, including original control/event/input digests. Observer off still retains mandatory hashes, routing/dispatch counters and flag/filter assertions; optional torque/motor/contact/metrics reads are removed.
protocol.release: Research only. No runtime source/default/UI/public candidate change. Existing failed support/cut candidates remain withdrawn; one-hand recovery remains held.

decision.actualWoundedEpisode: Same-state route requests separated; mild actual arm damage(.95265 remaining health), large solver-point-speed regression not reproduced. No efficacy or severe-injury claim.
decision.healthyCounterexample: Routing all paths to ordinary activation after identical candidate history leaves mean direction error almost unchanged (.98237/.98122rad) and raises .5s max sword K(4.205/5.561J). This does not establish activation reduction as a fix.
decision.causalWindows: Different recorded callbacks after .125/.11667s; under24step direct-mechanism window. .5s reactive-AI outcomes remain local total-episode effects. Persistent solver contacts need not be identical before callback divergence.
decision.braking: wristBrake latch entered0 times in both episodes; aimDamping and other control torques still act.
decision.next: Same sabre19 hold boundary: observe target angular velocity, current blade/relative angular velocity, toward/tgtSp, cap/release/brake condition terms and native elbow request-response before any new candidate. Do not sweep gains or revive withdrawn candidates.

limitations: Two selected diagnostic episodes, not random independent population samples.
Wounded case has mild actual main-arm damage; healthy case is not wounded efficacy.
same-event direct windows15/14steps are too short for a sustained .2s direct-braking conclusion.
All-ordinary diagnostic is not ordinary-from-spawn. Equal effort/torque/native work not imposed or measured.
Last-solver-substep point speed/normal impulse are not per-point loaded slip or COP.
No new product physics/UI/default changes and no human naturalness acceptance.
Wounded case has two same-mode observer repeats; healthy case has original-reference full replay, no new observer-off repetition.
